absent: Full layout of audit context, rule and entry structures beyond fields touched by these fragments.
Rule matching predicate and semantics of filter classes and operation discriminators.
Reader and writer synchronization for rule lists outside the mutex and read protection regions shown.
Audit buffer lifecycle, transport reliability and lost record accounting beyond early returns shown.
Security property representation and contracts for rule knowledge and object context reporting.
Path watch and tree linkage semantics including mark handling and chunk lifetime outside pin helpers.
Global enablement transitions and criteria for identifying the audit daemon task.
Producers that populate socket, IPC, message queue, capability, mapping, time and execve context fields.

findings.text: Bulk refresh of LSM backed audit rules across every filter class, attempting each entry while preserving the earliest failure for the caller.
Per task audit context creation plus rule count and signal counters are visible outside file scope for use by task lifecycle and control paths.
External hooks for task initialization and for LSM policy refresh provide the dossier boundary for audit setup and rule maintenance.
Refresh of LSM backed rules holds a dedicated filter mutex across the full sweep, so concurrent writers serialize and readers observe stable linkage updates.
Task and exit path filter scans run under read side protection, while rule replacement swaps linkage with grace aware primitives and defers reclamation of the old entry.
Auxiliary data anchor is a minimal chain node carrying a discriminator that selects among later payload variants.
Process identity auxiliary payload is a fixed capacity parallel collection for numeric identifiers, session values, security properties, command names and occupancy count.
Executable capability auxiliary payload records file capability state with versioning plus old and new process capability snapshots.
Tree reference storage is a singly linked chain of blocks each holding thirty one chunk references, used as segmented pinning stack.
Netfilter configuration operation table associates operation enumerators with stable audit names covering xt and nft families including registration, replacement, reset and invalid cases.
Return validity uses zero for invalid, one for success and two for failure.
Execve argument audit capture limit is 7500 bytes, constrained below eight kilobytes to preserve headroom.
Process title audit capture limit is 128 bytes.
Auxiliary process identity capacity is 16 entries.
Diagnostic output from this compilation unit carries a module derived prefix.
Auditable escalation is monotonic within a context, moving once from idle priority to record intent and leaving already prioritized contexts unchanged.

Context reuse preserves allocation identity while clearing per operation evidence, deriving priority from configured intent and retaining the filter key only for record intent, with dummy contexts skipping payload release.
Task filter evaluation defaults to build intent when no rule matches, and transfers filter key ownership to the caller only on record intent.
Uring exit and syscall exit filtering bypass the audit daemon task and otherwise evaluate their respective exit lists using the stored operation discriminator.
LSM rule refresh performs no change for rules unknown to the security layer, otherwise the duplicated rule replaces prior linkage and the old entry reclamation waits beyond reader grace.

Tree pinning consumes slots from the current block, grows by appending fresh blocks on exhaustion, unwinds only references beyond a checkpoint while restoring that checkpoint, and releases blocks separately from chunk release.

Special record rendering selects payload shape by context type across socket, IPC, message queue, capability, mapping, open, execve, module and time domains, emitting time records only for changed values or nonzero offsets and distinguishing clear, set and unknown capability states.
Execve evidence preserves argument count and per argument length with bounded capture, multi record continuation and safe encoding choice, treating uncopyable userspace as fatal to the audited task.
Process title handling bounds capture length, trims trailing non printable bytes with single byte edge care, and release clears both pointer and length.
Context teardown releases names with path resources, both auxiliary chains, module name when the module type applies, socket address and tree pins, resetting counts and handles to neutral values.
Audit intent moves among disabled, build and record, with allocation honoring never enabled fast path and disabled shutdown of syscall work, plus reset restoring live intent from configured intent.
Return validity starts invalid in fresh and reset contexts and may later reflect success or failure outcomes for the audited operation.
Tree reference storage cycles among empty chain, partially filled current block and chained overflow blocks, with growth adding blocks and unwind restoring earlier positions.

Allocation failures in rule duplication, context creation, tree block growth and execve staging avoid crashing, using diagnostics with lost record accounting or first error preservation while abandoning the current record.
Rule linkage mutation and tree pin release require grace aware handling because readers may still reference old entries, and error paths must unlink multiple memberships before deferred release.
